Community guidelines

A starting point for a community where everyone can find their own pace.

Draft · not yet effective. App-specific details require confirmation by the Footprint operator before launch. This page is a transparent preparation document, not a finalized app policy.

Respect every kind of progress

Proposed guideline: welcome different abilities, bodies, backgrounds, and goals. Encourage people without shaming their food choices, pace, or fitness level.

Keep location personal

Proposed guideline: do not share another person’s routes, home location, live whereabouts, photos, or personal details without their permission.

Move responsibly

Proposed guideline: respect trail access, local rules, other people, and changing conditions. Avoid encouraging dangerous challenges or unsafe behavior at events.

Keep the community useful

Proposed guideline: avoid harassment, hateful content, impersonation, spam, and misleading claims. Share encouragement and information honestly.

Reporting and moderation

Before these guidelines are finalized, Footprint must confirm its reporting, blocking, moderation, review, and appeal channels. This preview does not submit reports or promise a response time.
